designationHistory.indexText: Establishment of the Vermilion Cliffs National Monument

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 7374—Vermilion Cliffs National Monument, November 09, 2000

review.note: Proclamation 7374, 65 FR 69227, signed 2000-11-09; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President. Title names the monument only; the proclamation sets apart about 293,000 acres as a new monument, so this is an establishment.
